TextRenderer.text:
SHOP

Buy, upgrade, or remove
cards from your deck.

+ Guaranteed value
(no combat risk)

Interactable.onHoverEnter: var a = entity.getComponent('Anchor'); var anim = entity.getComponent('Animator'); if (a && anim) anim.animate(a, 'offsetY', -12, { duration: 0.16, easing: 'easeOut' });
Interactable.onHoverExit: var a = entity.getComponent('Anchor'); var anim = entity.getComponent('Animator'); if (a && anim) anim.animate(a, 'offsetY', 0, { duration: 0.18, easing: 'easeOut' });
